\chapter{Arithmetic Meets Bitwise: Carries and Borrows}
\label{ch:carries}

\begin{tcolorbox}[enhanced, colback=white, colframe=secondaryblue, boxrule=1pt, arc=2mm]
\textbf{\large\textcolor{primaryblue}{When $+$, $-$ and bitwise operators meet, the carries decide everything: when $a + b = a \mid b$, how $x - 1$ flips bits, and more.}}
\end{tcolorbox}
